original: tvāṃ, yadvā agrīyaṃ ukto'rthaḥ śamavantaṃ śāntaṃ aśanāyādyūrmiṣaṭkapratibhaṭamityarthaḥ | ‘yattacchāntamajaram' iti śruteḥ | iha asmin janmani śaraṇaṃ upāyaṃ rakṣitāraṃ ca vindāmahe | punaḥ itaḥparamapīti yāvat | pura eva ādāveva aśaṃ sukhavihīnaṃ ata eva ayuktaṃ āśrayaṇānarhaṃ ca | yadvā aśamayuktaṃ aśāntamityarthaḥ | śaraṇyāntaraṃ anyaṃ śaraṇyaṃ
analyzed: tvām yat vā agrīyam ukta ūrthaḥ śamavantam śāntam aśanāya ādi ūrmi ṣaṭka pratibhaṭam iti arthaḥ yat tat śāntam ajaram iti śruteḥ iha asmin janmani śaraṇam upāyam rakṣitāram ca vindāmahe punar itas param api iti yāvat puras eva ādau eva aśam sukha vihīnam atas eva ayuktam āśrayaṇa anarham ca yat vā aśam ayuktam aśāntam iti arthaḥ śaraṇya antaram anyam śaraṇyam

original: evetyarthaḥ | kiṃca vāsudevavāmadevaśabdayoḥ sumataḥ sukāramakārābhyāṃ sārvavibhaktikastasiḥ | bhedaḥ śrautaḥ kaṇṭharaveṇoktaḥ | anayoḥ evaṃ vidhayoḥ śabdayoḥ abhedaṃ vadan mūrkha evetyarthāntaramapi camatkārātiśayamādhatte | atra yo bhātītyādipūrvavākyārthena anayorabhidāmityādyuttaravākyārthassamarthyate ||

original: vaśinaṃ nārāyaṇamiha vadanti santatamanantanigamāntāḥ | yadi naśivaṃ taṃ brūyādyaḥ kaścitsa pratīpadṛṅnūnam || 1560 ||

original: anantāḥ nigamāntāḥ ‘sarvasya vaśī | eko vaśī ' ityādayaḥ upaniṣadaḥ saṃtataṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ‘eka ha vai nārāyaṇa asīt | atha puruṣo ha vai nārāyaṇo'kāmayata prajāssṛjeya' ityādiśrutibhissarvajagatkāraṇatvena joghuṣyamāṇamiti bhāvaḥ | vaśinaṃ vaśaḥ prabhutvaṃ āyattatvaṃ vā | so'syāstīti vaśī |
analyzed: anantāḥ nigama antāḥ sarvasya vaśī ekaḥ vaśī ityādayaḥ upaniṣadaḥ saṃtatam nārāyaṇam ha vai nārāyaṇa asīt atha puruṣaḥ ha vai nārāyaṇaḥ ukāmayata prajāḥ sṛjeya ityādi śrutibhiḥ sarva jagat kāraṇatvena joghuṣyamāṇam iti bhāvaḥ vaśinam vaśaḥ prabhu tvam āyattatvam vā saḥ usya asti iti vaśī

original: taṃ tathoktaṃ vadanti ‘vaśo janispṛhāyatneṣvāyattatvaprabhutvayoḥ' iti viśvaḥ | ‘jagadvaśe vartatedam' ityādikamapīha smartavyam | taṃ evaṃ vaśinaṃ sarveśvaraṃ yaḥkaścit naśivaṃ naśabdena samāsaḥ | akalyāṇaguṇaṃ brūyādyadi sa eva vaktā pratīpadṛk nūnaṃ viruddhārthadraṣṭaiva |

original: sarveśvaratvaupayikakalyāṇaguṇagaṇaparipūrṇamapyaśivaṃ brūyāccet tasya śrutipratikūlārthadṛktve kassaṃdeha iti bhāvaḥ | yadvā sarvaṃ jagadyadāyattamiti bravītiśrutiḥ tasya sarvaniyantuḥ ‘nārāyaṇādrudro jāyate' iti śivasyāpi kāraṇatayā tathaiva śrutyā pratipāditasya ‘śivaśca nārāyaṇaḥ' iti kaṇṭharaveṇoktaṃ kāryakāraṇatvanibandhanaṃ niyāmyani
analyzed: sarva īśvara tva aupayika kalyāṇa guṇa gaṇa paripūrṇam api aśivam brūyāt ced tasya śruti pratikūla artha dṛktve kaḥ saṃdehaḥ iti bhāvaḥ yat vā sarvam jagat yat āyattam iti bravīti śrutiḥ tasya sarva niyantuḥ nārāyaṇāt rudraḥ jāyate iti śivasya api kāraṇatayā tathā eva śrutyā pratipāditasya śivaḥ ca nārāyaṇaḥ iti kaṇṭha raveṇa uktam kārya kāraṇatva nibandhanam niyāmya niyāmya niyāmya niyāmya niyāmya niyāmya niyāmya niyāmya

original: yāmakabhāvanibandhanaṃ śarīrātmabhāvanibandhanaṃ vā sāmānādhikaraṇyamaviditvā taṃ naśivaṃ brūyādyadi tasya pratīpadarśitve ko viśaya iti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe vaśinamityānupūrvīmatpadaṃ naśivamiti vadeccet saḥ pratilomadṛṣṭireva | uktānupūrvyāḥ prātilomyena tathā niṣpatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yāmaka bhāva nibandhanam śarīra ātma bhāva nibandhanam vā sāmānādhikaraṇyam a viditvā tam naśivam brūyāt yadi tasya pratīpa darśi tve kaḥ viśayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ pakṣe vaśinam iti ānupūrvīmat padam naśivam iti vadet ced saḥ pratiloma dṛṣṭiḥ eva ukta ānupūrvyāḥ prātilomyena tathā niṣpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atrāpi vaśinamityādipūrvavākyārthena sa pratīpadṛgityuttaravākyārthasya samarthanas | pūrvasminnudāharaṇe bhagavato rudrasya ca niṣkṛṣṭarūpanibandhano bheda uktaḥ | iha tu śarīravācakaśabdānāṃ śarīriparyantatvanibandhanaṃ kāryakaraṇabhāvādinibandhanaṃ vā sāmānādhikaraṇyamavalambyābheda iti bodhyam ||

original: prāñcastu "bhedavaiṣamyayoḥ sphūrtau nālaṃkāradvayaṃ kalpyaṃ kiṃtūktālaṃkārābhāvamātraṃ, bhedavaijātyasphuraṇayoḥ svatassiddhatayā kavipratibhāgocaratāmūlakavaicitryavirahāt | na ca mīlitasāmānyarītibhyāṃ bhedaviśeṣasphūrtau tadapavādavarṇanakṛtavaicitryasadbhāvādalaṃkārāntarakalpanaṃ yuktamiti vācyaṃ, tāvatā vaicitryābhāvatādavasthyāt" ityāhuḥ |

original: yatra uttarātsākūtānnibadhyamānātpraśna unnīyate tatredamuttaram | na cedamanumānaṃ, pakṣadharmatvādinirdeśavirahāt | asakṛtpraśnapratipādanapūrvakaṃ sākūtamuttaraṃ dvitīyam | idameva gūḍhottaramiti vyavahriyate | yathā lakṣitaṃ kuvalayānande ‘kiṃcidākūtasahitaṃ syādgūḍhottaramuttaram' iti |

original: kiṃ cintayase bhadre iti kāṃcidgopalalanāṃ prati bhagavataḥ kṛṣṇasya praśnaḥ | kiṃ tvayītyādi tasyā uttaram | atrādyasya praśnasya cintāhetuṃ cedvadasi tadā pratikariṣyāmīti vyaṅgyam | uttarasya tu upabhogena vinā kevalapraśnottarābhyāṃ kaḥ pratīkārassyāditi | dvitīyasya tu praśnasya jñāta eva tvadabhiprāyaḥ |
analyzed: kim cintayase bhadre iti kāṃcid gopa lalanām prati bhagavataḥ kṛṣṇasya praśnaḥ kim tvayi ityādi tasyāḥ uttaram atra ādyasya praśnasya cintā hetum ced vadasi tadā pratikariṣyāmi iti vyaṅgyam uttarasya tu upabhogena vinā kevala praśna uttarābhyām kaḥ pratīkāraḥ syāt iti dvitīyasya tu praśnasya jñātaḥ eva tvad abhiprāyaḥ

original: athāpi tvadvadanāttaṃ śuśrūṣeyetyabhisaṃdhyudghāṭanam | uttarasya tu jñāta eva tvayā madabhiprāyaḥ kiṃ punaḥpunaḥ praśnakālayāpaneneti | unnītapraśne sakṛduttarasya cārutvaṃ, nibaddhapraśne tu praśnottarayorasakṛdupanyāse tat |
analyzed: atha api tvad vadanāt tam śuśrūṣeya iti abhisaṃdhi udghāṭanam uttarasya tu jñātaḥ eva tvayā mad abhiprāyaḥ kim punar punar praśna kāla yāpanena iti unnīta praśne sakṛt uttarasya cāru tvam nibaddha praśne tu praśna uttarayoḥ asakṛt upanyāse tat

original: ayaṃ cottarālaṃkāro dvividho'pi praśnottarayoranyatarasyobhayorapi sābhiprāyatvena nirabhiprāyatvena ca caturvidha ityaṣṭadheti prāñcaḥ | tatra prāthamike ‘tata itaḥ' iti padye unnītaḥ praśnaḥ kiṃ gaustvayā madīyā dṛṣṭetyākārakaścaturasārvabhaumeṇa bhagavatā kṛṣṇena vaktrā vaiśiṣṭyātsaṃbhogarūpeṇābhiprāyeṇa garbhitaḥ |
analyzed: ayam ca uttara alaṃkāraḥ dvividhaḥ api praśna uttarayoḥ anyatarasya ubhayoḥ api sa abhiprāya tvena nirabhiprāya tvena ca caturvidhaḥ iti aṣṭadhā iti prāñcaḥ tatra prāthamike tatas itas iti padye unnītaḥ praśnaḥ kim gauḥ tvayā madīyā dṛṣṭā iti ākārakaḥ catur asārvabhaumeṇa bhagavatā kṛṣṇena vaktrā vaiśiṣṭyāt saṃbhoga rūpeṇa abhiprāyeṇa garbhitaḥ

original: uttaramapi tenaivābhiprāyeṇa garbhitam | evaṃ nibaddhapraśne ‘kiṃ cintayase' iti padye'pi praśnottarayorubhayorapi sābhiprāyatvam | evamanyatarasābhiprāyaprabhedā apyudāhāryāḥ ||
analyzed: uttaram api tena eva abhiprāyeṇa garbhitam evam nibaddha praśne kim cintayase iti padye pi praśna uttarayoḥ ubhayoḥ api sa abhiprāya tvam evam anyatara sa abhiprāya prabhedāḥ api udāhāryāḥ

original: praśnottarayorubhayorapi nirabhiprāyatve unnītapraśnamuttaraṃ yathā
analyzed: praśna uttarayoḥ ubhayoḥ api nirabhiprāya tve unnīta praśnam uttaram yathā

original: iha vā'muṣminvā tvaṃ bahusukhamadhigamya vastumicchasicet | vṛjinapathaṃ vijahadimaṃ bhujagagirīnduṃ bhajasva niśśaṅkam || 1853 ||
analyzed: iha vā amuṣmin vā tvam bahu sukham adhigamya vastum icchasi ced vṛjina patham vijahat imam bhujaga giri indum bhajasva niśśaṅkam

original: vṛjinapathaṃ kuṭilamārgaṃ duritasaraṇiṃ vā | atra kasyaciddhitaiṣiṇaḥ puruṣasya kaṃcitpumāṃsaṃ pratyuttareṇa tatkartṛkasvahitānuśāsanapraśna unnīyate | tādṛśapraśnamantareṇa hitānuśāsanāyo

analyzed: gāt atra praśna uttarayoḥ ubhayoḥ api nirabhiprāya tā yathā avasthita artha jñāna nivedana para tvāt

analyzed: yathā vā

original: bhagavadbhāgavatārcanahetostṛṇamapi na jātu vitareyam | iti yadi kṛtaḥ paraḥ paṇa eṣa hi kṛpaṇaḥ kadaryaparyāyaḥ || 1854 ||
analyzed: bhagavat bhāgavata arcana hetoḥ tṛṇam api na jātu vitareyam iti yadi kṛtaḥ paraḥ paṇaḥ eṣa hi kṛpaṇaḥ kadarya paryāyaḥ

original: iti paraḥ atiśayitaḥ paṇaḥ kṛto yadi yenaivaṃ pratijñā kṛtetyarthaḥ | eṣa hi ayameva kṛpaṇaḥ ito'pyanyaḥ kaḥ kṛpaṇa iti bhāvaḥ | amumeva viśinaṣṭi kadaryeti | aryo vaiśyaḥ ‘aryassvāmivaiśyayoḥ' iti nipātito'yam | kutsitaścāsāvaryaśca kadaryaḥ 'koḥ kattatpuruṣe'ci' iti koḥ kadādeśaḥ | tasya paryāyaḥ sa evāyaṃ rūpāntaramāpanna iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: iti paraḥ atiśayitaḥ paṇaḥ kṛtaḥ yadi yena evam pratijñā kṛtā iti arthaḥ eṣa hi ayam eva kṛpaṇaḥ itas upi anyaḥ kaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ iti bhāvaḥ amum eva viśinaṣṭi kadarya iti aryaḥ vaiśyaḥ aryaḥ svāmi vaiśyayoḥ iti nipātitaḥ uyam kutsitaḥ ca asau aryaḥ ca kadaryaḥ iti koḥ kad ādeśaḥ tasya paryāyaḥ saḥ eva ayam rūpa antaram āpannaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: vaiśya eva nisargataḥ kṛpaṇaḥ tatrāpi kutsitatve tasya kārpaṇyaṃ kimu vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | pakṣe paṇaḥ paṇaśabdaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛvarṇāt ādyāditvātpañcamyāstasiḥ | paraḥ anantarabhāvī yadi eṣa eva kṛpaṇaḥ kṛpaṇaśabdaḥ kadaryaparyāyaḥ kadaryaśabdaparyāyatayā paṭhitaḥ | ‘kadarye kṛpaṇakṣudrakiṃpacānamitaṃpacāḥ' iti | atra kaḥ kṛpaṇa iti praśna unneyaḥ |
analyzed: vaiśyaḥ eva nisargataḥ kṛpaṇaḥ tatra api kutsita tve tasya kārpaṇyam kimu vaktavyam iti bhāvaḥ pakṣe paṇaḥ paṇa śabdaḥ kṛtaḥ kṛvarṇāt ādi ādi tvāt pañcamyāḥ tasiḥ paraḥ anantara bhāvī yadi eṣaḥ eva kṛpaṇaḥ kṛpaṇa śabdaḥ kadarya paryāyaḥ kadarya śabda paryāya tayā paṭhitaḥ kadarye iti atra kaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ iti praśnaḥ unneyaḥ

original: praśnottarayordvayorapyanākūtatvaṃ ca pūrvavadeva | upadarśitacamatkārastu viśeṣaḥ ||

original: iyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇena saha rantumutkaṇṭhitāyāḥ kasyāścidgopakāminyāssvabhartāraṃ prati vañcanoktiḥ | tathāhi he gopeti svabhartussaṃbuddhiḥ | tvaṃ alasaṃ mandaṃ udyogaṃ prayatnaṃ ehi | dūrajigamiṣāyāṃ hi mahānudyogaḥ kāryaḥ na tu savidhajigamiṣāyāmiti bhāvaḥ |

original: samut viviktaviharaṇasya pratyāsannatvātsānandassan mayā saha yogaṃ saṃgatiṃ ehi ratyarthaṃ madupāntaṃ prāpnuhīti bhāvaḥ | sahasā tvadupāntopasarpaṇe tvaṃ māṃ vilāsayervā na vetyāśaṅkāṃ parihartumāha vilāsaye iti | ratisukhavitaraṇenānandaye iti bhāvaḥ | vilāsavantaṃ karomīti vā | mā gāḥ atastvamidānīmanyato mā vrājīḥ |
